products.body_html:
Features:


Minimalistic sleek design 26.3L micro form factor chassis

Accommodates M-ATX and ITX motherboard with 4 slots 415mm large GPU

Supports up to 360 radiator and 10 x 120mm fans


The LIAN LI & DAN Cases A3-mATX is a versatile M-ATX mesh PC case that maintains a minimal chassis size while accommodating large components. Thanks to the relocatable PSU bracket, the A3-mATX empowers you to build a powerful and compact PC system tailored to your needs and preferences.


COMPACT DESIGN,MASSIVE POTENTIAL


Dive into the realm of compactness with the A3-mATX, which unlocks the potential of a small form factor PC case.


WELL VENTILATED, MINIMALIST DESIGN


With three sides featuring minimalist mesh panels and a sleek front panel, the A3-mATX combines functionality with style, making it the perfect touch to your setup.


EFFORTLESS MODULARITY, STREAMLINED BUILDS


The toolless removal of all exterior panels and modular brackets provide easier access for installation and cable management. With a removable bottom dust filter, ensuring the system stays clean and efficient.


VERSATILE COMPATIBILITY, ULTIMATE CUSTOMIZATION


Unleash your creativity with the flexible compatibility A3-mATX without compromising on high-performance, large size components.


The A3-mATX case accommodates a maximum CPU cooler height of 165mm and a 4-slot thick GPU with a maximum length of 415mm. Note that with a 25mm thick fan installed at the bottom, the GPU thickness will be limited to 61mm, allowing for only a 3-slot GPU. Additionally, when installing a radiator and fan combo, there will be no space for the GPU.


SPACE MAXIMIZED FOR COOLING


Maximizing the cooling capacity of this 26.3 liter case, 360mm AIO can be mounted to efficiently cool high-end components.


FLEXIBLE PSU INSTALLATION


Offers multiple mounting slots for a maximum of 220mm ATX/SFX/SFX-L or LIAN LI Edge PSU for ideal PSU placement to best suit your build requirements. 


SEAMLESS CONNECTIVITY, STYLISH IO


With its front IO featuring essential ports and buttons, along with a sleek and stylish front panel design, the A3-mATX ensures seamless connectivity while showcasing on the desk.
